page.layout: One title page. Top: title block in roman and italic type, centred. Middle: woodcut vignette (an arched gateway) with its Matthew 7:13 verse printed around it (top line, left and right vertical lines). Below the woodcut: place and printer lines, then the date. Manuscript annotation at right and shelf mark below the text are not printed text.

main_text.l: Bernæ affecti brevis historia: & contra eiusdem
in Polonia probare Baptismum non succes-
Auctore D. Benedicto Aretio, Bernensis Ecclesiæ
quoniam lata est porta, & spatiosa via,

page.notes: The verse around the woodcut is printed in small type on three sides of the engraving; its lines are given in reading order (top, left, right). The woodcut shows an arched gateway with a flaming urn above and plants below. Handwritten annotation at right in brown ink ("Obiit Benedictus Aretius Bernæ XX. Martij A° 1574") is not printed text and is left out. The shelf mark "Bc 3316" in pencil and the handwriting at the bottom edge are left out. Printed "Circuncisioni" is kept as printed. The "Mat. 7. 13." reference is printed on the right side of the woodcut as "Mat.7.13.", and the printed spacing was normalised here.
